Quick Answers

What's new in Series 11 vs Series 10?

Series 11 adds skin temperature sensing, a thinner 9.7mm design, and is currently $100 cheaper at $299. Series 10 does not have temperature sensing.

Is it worth upgrading from Series 9 or older?

Yes — the 40% larger display, fast charging (0–80% in 45 min), and new skin temperature sensor are significant quality-of-life improvements over Series 9.

How long does the battery last?

Up to 18 hours normally, or up to 36 hours in Low Power Mode. Most users charge every 1.5–2 days with moderate use.

Can I swim with it?

Yes — 50m water resistance. Perfect for swimming, surfing, or the ocean. Tap the water lock before diving in.
